metadata.title: Fried Anchovies | South Indian Recipe
metadata.description:
This is a very simple and easy to make south Indian dish. Anchovies are marinated and deep fried till they are crisp and served as a side to steamed rice. 

Ingredients

Anchovies - 1/2 kg
Shallot/Onion Paste - 1 Tbsp
Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 Tsp
Chili Powder - 2 Tbsp
Black Pepper Powder - 1/2 Tsp
Turmeric - 1/2 Tsp
Lime Juice - 1 Tbsp
Rice Flour - 2 Tbsp
Salt to taste
Oil for deep frying
